tex_content.html:
Proposition
[$L_U$ decomposes through $ abla $]

Source: petersen:page-0082, petersen:page-0083 ↗ def:pet-ch2-lie-derivative-vector-field ↗ def:pet-ch2-covariant-derivative-tensor ↗ def:pet-ch2-endomorphism-derivation

1. ch2:2.3.4Viewing $ abla U$ as the $(1,1)$-tensor $X\mapsto abla _XU$, the Lie derivative in the direction $U$ decomposes as $L_U= abla _U-( abla U)$, where $( abla U)$ acts by the endomorphism derivation of subsection 3.1.
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch2-lie-derivative-as-endomorphism-derivation

\sketch Both sides are tensor derivations, so it suffices to compare them on functions and vector fields. On functions, $( abla U)$ acts trivially and $L_Uf= abla _Uf$. On a vector field $Y$, torsion-freeness gives

\[ L_UY=[U,Y]= abla _UY- abla _YU = ig( abla _U-( abla U) ig)Y. \]

□
